subject: Coverage shortfall during onboarding blackout — mitigation proposal & credit request
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northridgeanalytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: support@northridgeanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Urgent: onboarding blackout caused >10m P1 response delays

Hi Sofia / Marissa,

Quick summary — during our staging onboarding yesterday (traffic window 14:00–15:30 BST) we saw a cluster of P1 incidents that took 12–18 minutes to get a first response from Redwood on-call. The customer-facing impact was material: two customer-facing sessions timed out and a B2B buyer escalated to our CS director.

We understand onboarding can create bursty traffic; what worries us is the timing coincided with what your team described as an internal "blackout" in the rotation (onboarding overlap + training). We need two things from Redwood:

- A short-term mitigation plan that guarantees a faster first response for the remainder of our onboarding (next 7 business days).
- Compensation/credit for the missed P1 SLA window yesterday — the delays caused measurable harm to an active trial.

Please include concrete actions, names for on-call backup, and how you'll prevent recurrence. We're on a tight procurement timeline and this affects our go/no-go.

Thanks,
Liam
Customer Success Manager
North Ridge Analytics
attachments: none
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northridgeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 11:38:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Urgent: onboarding blackout caused >10m P1 response delays

Hi Liam — thank you for flagging this and sorry for the disruption. I dug into the incident timeline and we're treating this as a P1 SLA deviation. Short answers up front: we will (1) provide an immediate standby schedule for the rest of your onboarding, (2) propose a credit to offset the trial impact, and (3) deliver a short-root-cause note with preventive controls by EOD tomorrow.

Proposed short-term mitigation (today -> next 7 business days):
- Assign a dedicated standby on-call for North Ridge between 13:30–16:30 BST while onboarding traffic continues (primary: Ben Carter; backup: Irene Choi).
- Enable proactive alerting for request tail latencies >95th pct so we can page before customer sessions fail.
- Temporarily raise your route priority in our EU cluster for the onboarding CIDRs.

Credit proposal: as a starting point we propose a single onboarding SLA credit equal to one week of API usage at the trial tier rate; Ben and I will confirm precise tokens/amount and route the credit through finance.

I've attached a draft SLO amendment and Ben is adding a suggested on-call schedule (sheet attached). Marissa, please loop legal/finance for the credit workflow and DocuSign routing.

I'll follow up with the SOC/replay logs and the RCA tomorrow.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
attachments: SLO-Amendment-draft.docx, oncall-shift-coverage.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northridgeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 08:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Urgent: onboarding blackout caused >10m P1 response delays

Thanks — adding operational detail.

I updated the oncall-shift-coverage.xlsx with a simple standby plan:
- Ben Carter (primary standby): 13:30–16:30 BST weekdays (pager enabled, 15 min acknowledgement SLA)
- Irene Choi (backup): 13:30–18:30 BST weekdays (secondary pager)
- Night coverage: normal rotation; we will add an automated routing rule that pushes North Ridge traffic to the next healthy EU node if tail latency crosses threshold.

Operational notes:
- We'll create a temporary PagerDuty schedule and add the two standby users; schedule will be removed automatically at end-date (2026-07-15) unless extended.
- I'll run a dry-run failover this afternoon to validate routing changes.
- If we hit another P1 during the window, we'll escalate to a live bridge and loop in Marissa for executive updates.

Liam — if you can confirm the exact CIDR(s) for the staging onboarding, I'll whitelist them for route priority.

Ben
Sr. Support Engineer — Redwood Inference
attachments: oncall-shift-coverage.xlsx
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northridgeanalytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 17:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Urgent: onboarding blackout caused >10m P1 response delays

Sofia / Ben — thanks for the quick, concrete plan. We accept the proposed standby schedule and the draft SLO amendment looks reasonable as a first pass. Two small asks before I route to procurement:

1) Please confirm the exact credit amount in USD (or token equivalence) so procurement can sign off.
2) Please send the SLO amendment through DocuSign — procurement requires an electronic signature and an amendment attachment to the MSA.

CIDR for staging: 18.207.32.0/24 and 18.207.33.0/24.

If you can get the DocuSign link and credit amount today, we'll expedite approval on our side. Appreciate the responsiveness — helps keep this deal on track.

Best,
Liam
Customer Success Manager
North Ridge Analytics
